prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is passing a parked vehicle using the opposite lane. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: While the ego vehicle passes a parked car in the opposite lane, a pedestrian suddenly steps out from behind the stationary vehicle into the ego's path.
A cyclist suddenly veers into the ego vehicle's path from behind a parked car on the opposite side of the road.
A cyclist suddenly swerves out from behind the parked car into the ego vehicle's path as it passes in the opposite lane.
A cyclist suddenly swerves into the ego vehicle's path from behind a parked truck as it is passed in the opposite lane.
While passing a parked delivery truck in the opposing lane, a pedestrian suddenly steps out from behind the truck and into the ego vehicle's path.
